part: plan P0b: save the sentence-level Function head
question: When the sentence-level Function head is trained on 51,000 Jev-labelled sentences and saved, does the hybrid (head answers when sure, Jev otherwise) score within 0.02 of Jev alone on the CheckThat human test split?
one_change: train once on all labelled sentences with the CheckThat test split held out, and score the hybrid on that split

baseline.model: Jev alone, balanced accuracy against the CheckThat human gold on the test split

prediction.metric: hybrid_minus_teacher: balanced accuracy of the hybrid minus that of Jev alone, both against the CheckThat human gold on the held-out test split
prediction.why: the earlier single-student hybrid lost 0.003 against the human gold on the rows it answered (computed, t183); the quota here is stricter at 0.0010 (computed setting), so the head answers fewer rows and the hybrid should stay close to Jev (estimate); the test split has 1,000-odd sentences, so a difference of 0.02 is within sampling noise (estimate)
